title: Irish Rhubarb Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy dessert combining the flavors of irish oats and rhubarb topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: Peel and chop rhubarb into 2-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, combine chopped rhubarb, sugar, and flour. Mix until rhubarb is evenly coated.
Transfer rhubarb mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, combine irish oats, brown sugar, and nutty granola. Mix until well combined.
Add cold unsalted butter to the oat mixture and use your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until crumbly.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the rhubarb.
Bake in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the rhubarb is tender.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
